scope: Proposition 7.1 (Good paths with bounded encounters) of the manuscript “Ground-state condensation in the dilute hard-sphere gas” (preprints/Ground-state-condensation-in-the-dilute-hard-sphere-gas-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 267 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3f861f3b57ec1d6a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 31. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix an integer R ≥ 1. There are constants p0, κ > 0, Cpath < ∞, and an integer K0, depending only on R, with the following property. Suppose K ≥ K0 and (7.1) holds with p ≤ p0. For every admissible ordered pair (v, w) there is a D-measurable event Ev,w of probability at least 1/2. On this event there is a measurable probability kernel on simple good nearest-neighbor paths from v to w. Two independent draws from this kernel, conditional on D, satisfy E [︂ 1Ev,w E [︂ eκJR(π,π′) | D ]︂]︂ ≤ Cpath. (7.3) The constants are uniform in the datum, its law, and the endpoint pair. For every sufficiently large K, at least υ0K6 ordered pairs are admissible.
